tier_a_sources.title: CompTIA Security+ 601 vs. 701: What's the Difference?

comptia_official_comparison.title: CompTIA Security+ 601 vs. 701: What's the Difference?
highlights: SY0-701 has five domains (same count as SY0-601) but 28 objectives vs. 35 on SY0-601.
About 20% of exam objectives were updated for current trends (automation, zero trust, hybrid/cloud, IoT, OT).
Security Operations grows from 16% to 28%; Program Management/Oversight grows from 14% to 20%.
New domain 1.0 General Security Concepts (12%) pulls controls, fundamentals, change management, and crypto basics out of the old 601 mix.

sy0_701_domain_focus.name: General Security Concepts
sy0_701_domain_focus.summary: Security controls, fundamental concepts, change management, cryptographic solutions.

sy0_701_domain_focus.name: Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Mitigations
sy0_701_domain_focus.summary: Threat actors, vectors, attack surfaces, vulnerabilities, mitigation, malicious-activity indicators.

sy0_701_domain_focus.name: Security Architecture
sy0_701_domain_focus.summary: Architecture models, data protection strategies, enterprise infrastructure principles, resilience and recovery.

sy0_701_domain_focus.name: Security Operations
sy0_701_domain_focus.summary: Day-to-day ops: monitoring, vulnerability management, asset management, IAM, automation/orchestration, incident response.

sy0_701_domain_focus.name: Security Program Management and Oversight
sy0_701_domain_focus.summary: Governance, risk management, third-party risk, audits/assessments, security awareness, compliance.

intro: Structured diff between official CompTIA SY0-601 and SY0-701 exam objectives PDFs, cross-checked against CompTIA's public 601 vs. 701 domain comparison. Use successor701 when triaging legacy-tagged items. Default SY0-701 pools exclude secplus-obsolete-question-archive.json entries.

weight_changes.note: Operations weight doubled; merged with implementation tasks
GRC expanded to Program Management and Oversight
